excerpt: In addition to noncompliance processes, we will (1) establish pathways for Anthropic staff to raise any issues related to this policy, including the overall risk levels of our models and implementation challenges; and (2) regularly review our compliance with this policy's procedural requirements.
paraphrase: Beyond noncompliance channels, Anthropic will create issue-raising pathways and conduct regular compliance reviews.

excerpt: Cases deemed to present minimal additional risk may be reported to the Board in quarterly summary reports.
paraphrase: Low-risk cases can be reported to the Board via quarterly summaries instead of individually.

excerpt: In cases where this policy is unintentionally ambiguous, we will act in accordance with the Responsible Scaling Officer or CEO's judgment, and aim to clarify the ambiguity in the next policy update.
paraphrase: Ambiguities will be resolved via RSO or CEO judgment, with clarification intended in a subsequent update.

excerpt: Employee agreements: We will not impose contractual non-disparagement obligations on employees, candidates, or former employees in a way that could impede or discourage them from publicly raising safety concerns about Anthropic.
paraphrase: Anthropic will not use non-disparagement clauses to discourage employees from raising safety concerns.

excerpt: If we offer agreements with a non-disparagement clause, that clause will not preclude raising safety concerns, nor will it preclude disclosure of the existence of that clause.
paraphrase: Any non-disparagement clause offered will not block safety-concern disclosure or disclosure of the clause itself.

excerpt: Policy changes: Changes to this policy will be proposed by the CEO and the Responsible Scaling Officer and approved by the Board of Directors, in consultation with the Long-Term Benefit Trust.
paraphrase: Policy changes are proposed by the CEO and RSO and approved by the Board with LTBT consultation.

excerpt: The current version of the RSP is accessible at www.anthropic.com/rsp. We will update the public version of the RSP before any changes take effect and record any differences from the prior draft in a change log.
paraphrase: The current RSP is published online, and any changes will be publicly updated before taking effect with differences logged.

context_stem: To advance the public dialogue on the regulation of frontier AI model risks and to enable examination of our actions, we commit to the following:
excerpt: Public disclosures: We will publicly release key information related to the evaluation and deployment of our models (not including sensitive details). These include summaries of related Capability and Safeguards reports when we deploy a model as well as plans for current and future comprehensive capability assessments and deployment and security safeguards.
paraphrase: Anthropic will publicly release non-sensitive information including report summaries at deployment and plans for capability assessments and safeguards.

excerpt: We will also periodically release information on internal reports of potential instances of non-compliance and other implementation challenges we encounter.
paraphrase: Anthropic will periodically release information about internal noncompliance reports and implementation challenges.

excerpt: Expert input: We will solicit input from external experts in relevant domains in the process of developing and conducting capability and safeguards assessments.
paraphrase: Anthropic will solicit external expert input during development and conduct of capability and safeguards assessments.

excerpt: We may also solicit external expert input prior to making final decisions on the capability and safeguards assessments.
paraphrase: Anthropic may also seek external expert input before finalizing assessment decisions.

excerpt: U.S. Government notice: We will notify a relevant U.S. Government entity if a model requires stronger protections than the ASL-2 Standard.
paraphrase: Anthropic will notify a relevant U.S. Government entity if a model needs protections beyond ASL-2.

excerpt: Procedural compliance review: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy's main procedural commitments (we expect to iterate on the exact list since this has not been done before for RSPs).
paraphrase: Anthropic will commission an annual third-party review of adherence to procedural commitments, expecting to refine the review's scope over time.

excerpt: This review will focus on procedural compliance, not substantive outcomes. We will also do such reviews internally on a more regular cadence.
paraphrase: The third-party review focuses on procedure not outcomes, and internal reviews will occur more frequently.

excerpt: It is possible at some point in the future that another actor in the frontier AI ecosystem will pass, or be on track to imminently pass, a Capability Threshold without implementing measures equivalent to the Required Safeguards such that their actions pose a serious risk for the world.
paraphrase: The footnote considers a future scenario where another AI actor exceeds a Capability Threshold without equivalent safeguards, posing serious world risk.
